promise.title: Accuracy over hype.
promise.body: AutoEco never invents financial figures. When data is missing, we say so. Estimates are labeled. Forecasts show assumptions.

trust.title: Your data stays yours
trust.subtitle: These are features you can use today, not promises.
trust.1.d: Download all your vehicles, fuel entries and expenses as CSV from Settings. Your data is not locked in.
trust.2.d: One click in Settings permanently deletes your account and scrubs your email address.
trust.3.d: We do not sell your data or run ads. Analytics events strip emails, names and vehicle identifiers.
trust.4.d: AutoEco is a financial tool. It will never tell you a car is safe or unsafe to drive.
cta.title: Ready to replace your guesses with numbers?
cta.body: Start free with one vehicle. Add your real fuel and expenses and AutoEco does the rest.
cta.secondary: Or try the calculator first — no account needed
